outputs.title: You don't know your offer (41 s)
outputs.notes:
Ready-to-post edit (Drive 14sX_Cjjjas2ymKLDFQrvh-OLP9KMYT5O). Pillar: SaaS math & ops. Caption:
The #1 thing I see on every coaching call: you don't know your offer.

Having software isn't an offer. Nobody pays you just because you can provide a service.

Comment MATH and I'll send you how I build one.

#highlevel #saas #agencyowner

outputs.title: The value equation (35 s)
outputs.notes:
Ready-to-post edit (Drive 110gOTsTrcv6vLemNyHtCk-GtHLo8kiMJ). Pillar: SaaS math & ops. Caption:
The one book every student of mine reads: $100M Offers.

Raise the dream outcome and the odds of success. Cut the time delay and the effort. That's the whole value equation.

Comment MATH for my offer worksheet.

#highlevel #saas #agencyowner

outputs.title: "I do this, can I do it for you?" (37 s)

"I do this. Can I do it for you?" rarely gets you a client.

#highlevel #saas #agencyowner
